analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for the fourth consecutive day. ADX is at 25.9, indicating a clear trend, but the downward pressure is dominant as +DI (19.4) is lower than -DI (27.9). Weekly RSI is 44.3 and weekly MACD histogram is 0.0017, still in a weak zone. Current price ($0.08) aligns with swing support/resistance and overlaps with SMA5/20/100 ($0.08) and EMA50 ($0.08). Consolidation near the Bollinger Band middle line ($0.08) shows a lack of directional momentum. Volume ratio to 5-day average is 1.21, at a normal level. 52-week position at 9.1% remains low.
